_about: Rim Factions v2 design sheets. Source of truth: change a row here before changing code. Each row is one thing; each column one property. tools/preflight.ps1 checks every cell, every cross-reference, and that every row id appears in src/.
_model: Each player plays their own save (no lockstep, no desyncs). A link (Steam P2P relay, or TCP for LAN/local) joins the games: roster, planet markers, goodwill, news, gifts and trips. Live Multiplayer sessions open only for 'Start together' and 'live help' trips.

rows.note: Most players on one planet (host included)
Max goodwill one item gift earns
Goodwill when a help trip arrives
Help trips stay at most 1 day
Once helpers have seen a fight, they leave after this long with no threats
Colonists a joining player brings when starting together
The call letter expires after 6 hours
Fighters one click sends (never the last colonist)
First assault 2 days into the host's session
Help sent within a day counts
Raid strength vs the storyteller's normal big threat
Melty reads the address after this

rows.label: Gift to colony
rows.trigger: gizmo on item stacks on your home map
rows.effect: items vanish here and land at the friend's colony by drop pod; unknown modded items arrive as silver of equal value

rows.label: Gift colonist
rows.trigger: gizmo on a free, healthy colonist
rows.effect: colonist leaves here and joins the friend's colony by drop pod

rows.label: Send to colony: help, AI
rows.trigger: gizmo on selected colonists > friend > Help > AI
rows.effect: colonists go away from your map; in the friend's game they drop in as allies (AssistColony) and leave when calm; survivors come home with injuries and gear

rows.label: Send to colony: raid, AI
rows.trigger: gizmo on selected colonists > friend > Raid > AI
rows.effect: colonists walk in from the map edge as hostile raiders (AssaultColony); survivors who flee come home; downed raiders can be captured

rows.label: Send to colony: help, live
rows.trigger: gizmo on selected colonists > friend > Help > Live
rows.effect: friend accepts; their game opens a live co-op session with your colonists dropped in; your game saves and joins; 'Send visitors home' ends it, survivors return to your save and both games go back to solo

rows.label: Shared saves
rows.trigger: a shared game (lobby game, together session) is saved or loaded; a link connects
rows.effect: each save is copied to the shared cloud folder (Mod settings: a Google Drive / OneDrive / Dropbox folder all players share) and sent in chunks to the other players; loading a shared game picks the newest copy (in-game time, then real time); copies played apart are kept side by side with a warning
rows.live_session: only the Multiplayer host's save is shared

rows.label: Ask the host
rows.trigger: friend's welcome window or Rim Factions window when the host has neither a together session nor a lobby open
rows.effect: Join <host>'s colony / Start a new game together with <host> send message:WantTogether; the host gets a popup that opens their colony for playing together (feature:StartTogether) or the lobby (feature:Lobby, leaving their current game for the main menu first); the asking friend is taken in automatically once it's open

rows.label: New game with friends
rows.trigger: main menu: Rim Factions > Start a new game with friends (host); friends linked to the planet get the lobby window
rows.effect: host picks Together or Separate and the starting relation (allied, neutral, rival) applied to every pair of players in the lobby; friends pick a color and mark ready; Start sends the host through RimWorld's new-game screens; Together: the host's new colony opens a together session and friends join it automatically (feature:StartTogether); Separate: once the host's colony is on the planet, friends' own new-colony setup opens on that planet

rows.label: Land together
rows.trigger: together lobby: the host reaches RimWorld's colonist page
rows.effect: the lobby state gets stage=pawns and friends' lobby windows ask them to make their colonists now (feature:MakeColonistsEarly); a friend's finished colonists go to the host as message:MyColonists, which marks them ready; the host's colonist page lists who's ready; on Start (asking first if someone isn't) friends' colonists are built from PawnData into the starting colonists, so everyone's land in the same starting drop pods, and are tagged as their owners' when the together session opens

rows.label: Make my colonists now
rows.trigger: together lobby, before or while the host sets up the world
rows.effect: the friend goes straight to RimWorld's colonist page (a small background setup like RimWorld's quick start, with the host's scenario and storyteller from the lobby state; no scenario, storyteller, world or site screens); Start on the colonist page keeps setting:TogetherStartPawns colonists as PawnData and returns to the menu; on joining the session they are built in every game at once (synced) and drop into the colony as the friend's own, instead of feature:MakeColonists

rows.label: Your own scenario
rows.trigger: a friend's colonist maker opens (feature:MakeColonistsEarly)
rows.effect: the friend first picks a scenario (the host's, sent as a scenario file, is preselected); their colonists are made in it, limited to the lobby's colonists-each slider and never more than that scenario starts with, except that units the scenario requires at the start (required kinds/xenotypes count as the player's own colonist, required mutants such as a ghoul come on top) always fit; the scenario file travels with their colonists (message:MyColonists scen) so their starting kit is their scenario's

rows.label: Everyone's starting kit
rows.trigger: a friend's colonists land in a together colony (at the start with feature:LandTogether, or later)
rows.effect: the friend also gets their own scenario's starting things (feature:OwnScenario; the host's scenario if they made colonists another way) (PlayerStartingThings of every part, plus the resources scattered near the start) by drop pod next to their colonists, once per player; the host's own came with the scenario

rows.label: Shared work tab
rows.trigger: personal colonists are on (feature:OwnColonists)
rows.effect: the Work tab lists only your colonists; a Shared work tab next to it lists colonists nobody owns, for every player

rows.label: Your own colonists
rows.trigger: automatic in a shared colony with two or more owners; host rule (Mod settings) can turn it off
rows.effect: other players' colonists can't be selected or ordered (a message says whose they are), and Work / Schedule / Assign list only your colonists; colonists nobody owns stay everyone's; the info panel shows the owner; the Rim Factions window can claim unowned selected colonists, and the host can give selected colonists to a player; owners are logged once per session

rows.label: Make your colonists
rows.trigger: joining a together session
rows.effect: the joiner's colonists are generated in every game at once (synced) and wait off the map; the joiner sees RimWorld's character card and can randomize (any, man, woman), rename, then drop them into the colony by drop pod

rows.label: Player colors
rows.trigger: lobby, or Mod settings > Just for you
rows.effect: each player picks a color from 12; it's sent in their Hello and used for their name tags, map marker and roster stripe; in a shared game each player's color is also kept in the game under their session name (synced), which name tags use first

rows.label: Player name tags
rows.trigger: automatic when pawns of two or more players share a map
rows.effect: each player's name shows above their pawns in their color; can be turned off in Mod settings

rows.label: Play together on this colony
rows.trigger: host: Rim Factions tab > Invite friends to this colony; joiner: join dialog > Join live
rows.effect: live co-op session on the host's colony; each joining player gets setting:TogetherStartPawns colonists of their own, tagged as theirs, made in feature:MakeColonists

rows.label: Leave to found own colony
rows.trigger: gizmo on your own colonists during a together session
rows.effect: your colonists leave as a caravan on the same planet; your game turns into your own save without the shared colony (it becomes a friend marker); settle anywhere

rows.label: Call friends for help
rows.trigger: alert while a hostile threat is on your home map, setting:HelpCallCooldownTicks apart
rows.effect: every online friend gets a letter; 'Send N fighters' sends their best fighters as a help trip (feature:TripHelpAI)

rows.label: Trade with a friend's colony
rows.trigger: caravan float menu on a friend colony marker (friend online, not hostile)
rows.effect: the friend's game sends its stockpiles and home-area items (forbidden ones stay hidden); the vanilla trade screen opens; the deal leaves their stockpile and pays them by drop pod

rows.label: Planet-wide assault
rows.trigger: hub, every setting:PlanetEventEveryTicks of the host's clock, with setting:PlanetEventMinPlayers online colonies
rows.effect: every colony gets a mech or raider assault; colonies that send help to another within setting:PlanetEventDurationTicks get setting:PlanetEventRewardSilver silver

rows.label: Rim Factions mod settings
rows.trigger: Options > Mod settings > Rim Factions
rows.effect: turn features on/off (call for help, trade, assaults, raids, live visits, playing together) and tune goodwill, helping, assault and together numbers; the host's rules apply to the whole planet (system:PlanetRules)

rows.label: Use their mod list
rows.trigger: join welcome screen, or Compare mods: Use <friend>'s mod list
rows.effect: gets the friend's full active list in load order (message:ModList), subscribes to and downloads the Workshop mods you lack, saves your own list, sets yours to theirs and restarts RimWorld (asks first if a game is open); Restore my own mod list switches back; mods that can't be downloaded are listed and left out

rows.label: Compare mods
rows.trigger: Rim Factions window: a friend's row; or the join welcome screen
rows.effect: asks the friend's game for its mod list; shows mods each side lacks (Workshop links for theirs) and every mod's live-play rating from the Multiplayer team's compatibility list; the Rim Factions stack itself is left out

rows.label: Welcome to a friend's planet
rows.trigger: joiner arrives from a join link and the hub welcomes it (main menu or in game)
rows.effect: a window offers: join their colony live (when a together session is open), start my own colony on this planet, or keep playing my own save; shown once per join

rows.label: Start on my friend's planet
rows.trigger: joiner: join dialog > Start my own colony
rows.effect: the new-world page is pre-filled with the host's seed and settings so both colonies share one planet

rows.fields: def, stuff, quality, hitPoints, count, value
rows.rebuild: ThingMaker.MakeThing(def, stuff); quality; HP; stack; unknown def -> silver of 'value'

rows.fields: expansions: psylink level, abilities (not role powers), royal titles+favor, tattoos, non-cosmetic endo/xeno genes + custom xenotype name/icon, mutant, mechs (kind+health); base: id, kind, gender, ageBio, ageChrono, name(first,nick,last), childhood, adulthood, traits[def,degree], skills[def,level,passion,xp], head, body, hair, beard, hairColor, skinColor, xenotype, hediffs[def,part,partIndex,severity,permanent], apparel[ItemData], equipment[ItemData], inventory[ItemData]
rows.rebuild: PawnGenerator then overwrite each field; on return to the original pawn only health and gear are applied

rows.purpose: AI trip pawns leaving a map are recorded as survivors
live sessions default to Steam, 4 players, one faction

rows.does: accepts up to setting:MaxPlayers players, relays messages, keeps roster/goodwill/world params, queues messages for offline players (saved to {localappdata}/RimFactions/hub.xml)
connects to the hub (from --join or the tab's address field), sends Hello on connect and on game load, reconnects
Steam P2P packets on setting:LinkSteamChannel, accepted from peers; relayed by Steam so no port forwarding
length-prefixed TCP on setting:LinkTcpPort (loopback, or all interfaces with RIMFACTIONS_LAN=1)
friend colonies drawn as world-map markers at their tile; Rim Factions tab lists players, goodwill, online state
symmetric goodwill per pair, -100..100, start 0; hostile/ally thresholds; relation changes make news
News messages become letters in every player's game
map component tracking AI trip pawns until they leave, die or are captured, then sends TripReturn
game component keeping the original colonists as world pawns while away; applies TripReturn (health, gear) and drops them home
host: HostProgrammatically from the solo game, then ConvertToSp when done; joiner: saves home game, connects, reloads home save after

writes 'Hosting at <steamid64>.steamlobby' (a host name Melty hands joiners) to setting:LogFile when the hub opens, nothing without Steam; writes 'Melty joined: <address>' once the hub welcomes this game
each Hello carries a per-start id; when a friend's game says hello from a new start, the host disconnects that friend's old Steam player in Multiplayer, which otherwise blocks their rejoin forever
